component.name: WoeUSB-GUI
component.summary: Create bootable Windows USB drives on Linux

description.p: WoeUSB-GUI is a modern, responsive Linux desktop application for creating bootable Windows USB installation media from ISO images.
Designed to operate safely and reliably across modern Linux distributions (Arch Linux, Fedora, Ubuntu, Debian, BigLinux, and Manjaro), packaged universally as a Flatpak:

ul.li: Strictly filters removable USB drives (>= 2 GB), completely hiding and protecting system disks and partitions
Extracts Windows ISO files directly in user space without requiring loop mounts or elevated privileges
Automatically splits install.wim files larger than 4 GB into .swm parts for full FAT32 UEFI Secure Boot compatibility
Handles drive formatting and mounting via standard unprivileged UDisks2 D-Bus daemon
Real-time asynchronous progress reporting, speed estimation, and detailed diagnostic logs

screenshot.caption: Main application interface showing ISO selection and target USB device

ul.li: Safe USB drive detection preventing accidental overwrites
FAT32 UEFI Secure Boot support with automatic WIM splitting
Modern PySide6 and Qt 6 graphical interface
